verdict.rationale: PostHog's feature-flag docs cover all three targeting elements. Flags roll out by person property, cohort, or group, and percentage rollouts (e.g., 1% of users) can be switched off without a redeploy. The Slack agent example shows a flag rolled out by an email property, and the MCP inventory lists a dedicated feature-flags tool family. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of flag targeting, in-depth docs on targeting rule mechanics (e.g., combining conditions, rollout bucketing behavior).
